name: getSettings
description: Shows how the wall is set up, including the message pinned at its top.

callback.description: Runs when the settings are read.

error.description: Why it didn't work, if it didn't.

allowAutoSubscribe.description: Whether people join the wall automatically when they open it.

disableFollowLeaveGroup.description: Whether the join and leave button is hidden.

showMembers.description: Whether people can see the list of members.

allowCommunityFeedFollow.description: Whether people can follow each other.

chatFeature.description: How private chats open: the plugin's own chat or an action item.

chatFeatureAction.description: What opens a private chat when the action item is chosen, if one is set.

action.description: What kind of action it is, such as opening a website.

actionItem.description: The extra button's action on the wall, if one is set.

action.description: What kind of action it is, such as opening a website.

pinnedPost.description: The message pinned at the top of the wall, as formatted text, if there is one.
